intuition: Each number needs its own candidate indices, but replacements make old heap entries stale.

brute_force.approach: Scan every occupied index to find the smallest one containing the requested number.

optimal.approach: Map indices to current numbers and keep a min-heap of candidate indices per number, removing stale tops lazily.
optimal.time: change O(log n), find O(log n) amortized

edge_cases: Changing an index to its current number does not affect the answer.
A number with no current index returns -1.
